speaker: Doctor
text: Do you have any history of placenta previa or placental abnormalities noted during your prenatal ultrasounds? Given your previous cesarean section, I need to rule out uterine rupture or placental issues.

text: My main symptom is Vaginal bleeding. I also have Severe abdominal pain, History of contractions that stopped, Previous cesarean delivery.

text: Do you feel any vaginal pressure or a sense of something protruding, and has the fetus moved normally today? I need to assess for signs of uterine rupture or placental abruption given your history and symptoms.

speaker: Patient
text: Past medical history: One previous childbirth via cesarean section. No other significant past medical history. Social history: Non-smoker, occasional alcohol consumption. Works as an elementary school teacher.

speaker: Doctor
text:
Given your history of a prior cesarean section and the sudden cessation of contractions accompanied by severe pain and bleeding, I am highly concerned for uterine rupture. I need to immediately assess the fetal well-being and confirm the diagnosis.
